categories.label: Person names (supervisors, PIs, staff)

placeholders.role: the person's role in the network, such as supervisor
placeholders.code: a letter and a two-digit number, fixed for the person

categories.note: Initials, possessives, diacritic variants and names split across a line break are the same person.
categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, person names row.

categories.label: Institutions, departments, companies

placeholders.role: the organisation's role in the network, such as beneficiary or associated partner
placeholders.code: a letter and a number, fixed for the organisation
placeholders.kind: the kind of organisation, such as university or company
placeholders.participation_status: EU Member State, associated country or third country

categories.note: A department takes the code of its organisation.
categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, institutions row; participation status kept under O4.

categories.label: Project acronym and title

placeholders.pseudonym: one invented acronym and title, fixed across the document

categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, project acronym row.

categories.label: Cities, regions, countries

placeholders.place_descriptor: the kind and size of a place below country level, such as a capital city or a coastal region

categories.example: a capital city, with its country kept
categories.note: Every location below country level is generalised. The country and each participant's EU Member State, associated country or third country status are kept, because evaluators score the network's geography.
categories.basis: O4 in the AN0 record; the operator confirmed in session on 2026-10-15 that country names are kept.

categories.label: Unique facilities and named infrastructure

placeholders.scale: the facility's reach, such as national or regional
placeholders.facility_type: what the facility is, kept specific enough to judge feasibility

categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, facilities row.

categories.label: Named datasets and cohorts

placeholders.scale: the dataset's reach, such as national or multi-site
placeholders.dataset_type: what the dataset is, such as longitudinal cohort
placeholders.size_band: the size rounded to a band

categories.example: a national longitudinal cohort (n in 1,000 to 1,999)
categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, datasets row.

categories.label: Prior and current grants (ids, acronyms, funders when identifying)

placeholders.scheme_class: the kind of grant, such as consolidator-stage or doctoral network

categories.note: Grant ids and grant acronyms always go. A funder goes only where naming it identifies the holder.
categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, grants row.

categories.label: Self-citations and citations of consortium members

placeholders.n: the marker's place in the reference list

categories.note: Each matching reference list entry becomes a neutral placeholder, so the list keeps its length.
categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, self-citations row.

categories.label: Niche topic combinations
categories.note: Flagged for A3 and A5. Rewritten in A3 only where the A5 attack shows the combination identifies the network.
categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, niche topics row.

categories.label: Numbers that identify (budgets per partner, staff counts, h-index)

placeholders.band: the value rounded to a band

categories.note: Timing and effort figures that do not identify anyone are kept as they are.
categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, identifying numbers row.

categories.label: Figures with logos, maps, photos, names
categories.note: The operator looks at each figure and redraws or masks it. No figure is silently dropped.
categories.basis: Handoff section 5 A1 table, figures row.

kept_content: Timing and effort figures that do not identify anyone

targets.basis: O3 in the AN0 record: zero correct guesses for institutions.
O3 in the AN0 record: zero correct guesses for institutions.
O3 in the AN0 record: zero correct guesses for people.
O3 in the AN0 record: zero correct guesses for the acronym.
O3 in the AN0 record: the country set may be guessed when the policy keeps it, and this policy keeps the country.
AN0 known gap: O3 sets no threshold for the research group. AN8b may not run until the operator sets one.
